text:
sasha: Starting a short reconcile for KMS grants that show no owner in the entitlement map. Goal: build a safe demotion whitelist and catch orphaned grants.

jules: saw ~47 grants last 30 days where owner_email IS NULL. some look like short-lived support elevations. we shouldn't demote those blindly.

owen: query to reproduce my set: 
```
SELECT g.grant_id, g.principal, g.created_at, g.requestor, e.ticket_id
FROM kms_grants g
LEFT JOIN entitlement_map m ON m.principal = g.principal
LEFT JOIN audit_events e ON e.grant_id = g.grant_id
WHERE m.owner_email IS NULL
  AND g.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY g.created_at DESC;
```

lee: FYI the support-lambda had a noisy retry last week; i've revoked duplicates. also found webhook timeouts causing missing ticket_id on ~8 grants (`Webhook error: Timeout 504`).

anita: i can backfill ticket_id & requestor where audit_events exist. will run a safe update and write a dry-run first.

infra-bot: Automation note: planned prune job "orphan-entitlement-pass" scheduled 2026-04-08T02:00Z. Default grace_days=7. Run will skip grants with `created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'`.

sasha: please pause that run until we produce a whitelist. propose: (1) extend grace_days to 14 for this pass, (2) exclude grants where `audit_events.ticket_id IS NOT NULL`, (3) backfill missing metadata before demotion.

jules: +1. i'll collate the orphan list and mark which ones have matching audit_events.

owen: i'll open infra PR to change grace_days and add an `exclude_ticketed=true` flag.

anita: starting dry-run backfill now, will post results in ~30m. won't touch grants < 48h old.

sasha: summary action items: anita backfill dry-run, jules collate orphan list with audit match, owen PR to add exclude flag + grace change, lee verify webhook retry backoff fix. Pause automation until whitelist posted.

infra-bot: Action recorded: hold prune until label `hold-orphan-pass` applied to infra/tools/admin-prune PR.
